name: Summer Science Research Program (SSRP)
what_you_do: This is seven weeks of team-based, mentored lab research on campus. You work with scientists from Rockefeller, MSK and Weill Cornell. You choose a question and collect data. You present a poster at the end.
grades: Current high school juniors and seniors
who_can_apply: Current high school juniors or seniors who are at least 16 when the program starts. Students from outside NYC and outside the Tri-State area may apply but get no help with housing or travel. No GPA minimum. Sophomores are not eligible.
pay_detail: Free to apply and attend. An OMNY card covers NYC transit. Stipends are not guaranteed; need-based stipends may go to students with financial hardship who meet all attendance rules.
duration: 7 weeks, Mon Jun 21 to Thu Aug 5, 2027, full time (about 35 hours a week, roughly 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.).
deadline_text: Applications for SSRP 2027 are open. Deadline: Monday, January 4, 2027 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern. Late applications will not be considered.
how_to_apply: Apply online. You also need a letter of recommendation and a transcript (to show you are in high school). Selected applicants get a Zoom interview.
notes: Very competitive (about 32 students a year). You must attend the entire program with no gaps. Minors cannot work with human patients. You may not use SSRP work in science competitions. Contact: program administrator listed on the page, 1230 York Ave.
